Hi all — quick AP checklist and mapping notes from our side: 

1) Legal name vs DBA: AP needs the legal name on the W-9 to match the vendor master exactly. If Compass operates as a DBA, please include the DBA line as an alternate name.
2) PO routing: we default to AP-INT-ERP when the vendor will receive POs through our ERP integration. If Compass prefers email invoicing (PDFs), we'll use AP-GL-EMAIL and set the invoice ingestion address.
3) Tax/Billing: please confirm whether Compass is set up to receive ACH or wire — if ACH, we'll request the account number + routing in a secure transfer (redacted in email).
4) CLAUSE: for companies with multiple legal entities, list each EIN and the matching remit address to avoid misrouting invoices.

Action items for vendor (Olivia):
- Attach signed W-9 with legal name exactly as it appears on tax docs
- Attach redacted banking instruction file (bank name + last 4 digits OK)
- Confirm preferred PO channel: ERP or email ingestion

Once we receive these we will: create supplier stub, assign vendor id, map PO channel, and send a short confirmation with vendor_id and next steps.

Thanks,
